## Today · Constructing a straight line {#fv3-construct .fv-lesson .line-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>Today we will construct vector equations of <strong>straight lines</strong> and connect them to Cartesian equations.</p><div data-line-construction></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet §§3.1–3.2 · pp. 36–38</div>

::: {.notes}
We will explore other curves later in the unit. Begin with O and A=(3,0). Step 1: choose d=(−1,2), parallel to the line. Step 2: AP=λd; show positive, zero and negative multiples. Step 3: OP=OA+AP=a+λd. The position vector always begins at O. What is enough to construct a line? One point and one non-zero direction vector. Connect to (3−t)i+2tj=3i+t(−i+2j).
:::
